en.headline: Aircraft worker dies after falling from platform at Hong Kong airport
en.dek: A 62-year-old maintenance worker fell about six metres while repairing an aircraft fuselage at a HAECO hangar; the Labour Department has launched an investigation and issued a suspension notice.
body: A 62-year-old aircraft maintenance worker died on Monday after falling from a work platform about six metres high while carrying out repairs on an aircraft fuselage inside a hangar operated by Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Company at Hong Kong International Airport.

Police said the incident was reported at about 8.35 am. Preliminary inquiries indicated the worker had stepped into a gap between two platforms. He was found unconscious with head injuries and was taken to North Lantau Hospital, where he was later certified dead. The case is being treated as an industrial accident.

The Labour Department said it had commenced an on-site investigation and expressed sympathy to the worker’s family. It issued a suspension notice requiring the employer to stop using the fuselage dock until suitable safety measures were in place. HAECO said it was supporting the family and colleagues and cooperating fully with the authorities.

zh.headline: 赤鱲角飛機維修工墮下不治 勞工處展開調查
zh.dek: 一名62歲維修工人在港機工程機庫維修飛機外殼時由約6米高工作台墮下，勞工處已展開調查並發出停工通知。
body: 一名62歲飛機維修工人星期一在香港國際機場港機工程公司機庫內，維修飛機外殼時由約6米高的工作台墮下，其後不治。
警方表示，接報時間約為上午8時35分。初步調查顯示，該名工人疑踏空墮入兩工作台之間的空隙。他頭部受傷昏迷，由救護車送往北大嶼山醫院，其後證實死亡。案件列作工業意外處理。
勞工處表示已派員到場調查，並向死者家屬致以慰問，同時向僱主發出停工通知書，要求暫停使用有關機身工作台，直至採取適當安全措施為止。港機工程表示正全力支援家屬及同事，並全力配合當局調查。
